summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute heavily obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package advertises itself as a small Vue button component but declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, probes for `bun` on PATH and otherwise downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases for the detected platform/architecture (with Alpine/musl detection via `ldd` and `/etc/os-release`), unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` single-expression bundle using shuffled string arrays and function-array rotation (`WV8StW`), with no relation to a UI button component. The `setup.mjs` loader itself is also obfuscated with `_0xNNNNNN` identifier renaming and string-indirection tables typical of obfuscator.io output. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper (pulling Bun specifically to execute code that Node-focused scanners will not read) with a large obfuscated sibling payload whose name and content are unrelated to the package's stated purpose is a supply-chain attack shape: installing this package runs arbitrary attacker-authored code on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
